hints.title: Consecutive Prior Smaller Price Compression
hints.text: The span of today price aggregates today single day with the accumulated spans of all consecutive preceding days whose prices were less than or equal to today.

hints.title: Monotonically Decreasing Price Accumulation
hints.text: Pop entries whose price is less than or equal to current price, adding their accumulated spans into current day span before recording the new pair.

hints.title: StockSpanner Next Blueprint
hints.text: Initialize span = 1. While container not empty and container top price <= current price: span += container.pop().span. Push (price, span) and return span.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Each element is pushed and popped at most once across the sequence yielding amortized O(1) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning backward linearly on every day takes O(N^2) total worst-case time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing compressed spans avoids re-examining already dominated past days.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Compressing predecessor spans inside monotonic container elements.

solutions.approach: Monotonic Decreasing Stack with Compressed Spans
